skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content: A shell made of various materials, the latest optimized internal frame, unique protective coating, and special omnidirectional wheels — a unified, all-encompassing design suited for the modern era. A new legend is born for Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.

skins.name: Dual-threat Quarterback
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Dual-threat Quarterback. No matter who popularized the sport, THRM-EX is its #1 fan. As for his teammates... They're mainly other operation platforms.
skins.quote: A quarterback is responsible for organizing every offensive play, but THRM-EX much prefers cradling the ball and charging in!
